labeled_yaml_examples.yaml:
apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: PodChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
  labels:
    app: target-workload
    component: target-workload
    role: target-workload
    tier: target-workload
spec:
  action: pod-kill
  mode: one
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: PodChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  action: pod-kill
  mode: one
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  scheduler:
    cron: '@every 2h'
  duration: 30s

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: PodChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  action: pod-failure
  mode: all
  duration: 5m
  selector:
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: NetworkChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  action: delay
  mode: all
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  direction: both
  target:
    mode: all
    selector:
      namespaces:
      - target-namespace
      labelSelectors:
        app: target-workload
  delay:
    latency: 3000ms
    correlation: '0'
    jitter: 0ms
  duration: 150s

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: NetworkChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  action: partition
  mode: all
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  direction: both
  target:
    mode: all
    selector:
      namespaces:
      - target-namespace
      labelSelectors:
        app: target-workload
  duration: 75s

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: NetworkChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  action: duplicate
  mode: one
  selector:
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  duplicate:
    duplicate: '40'
    correlation: '25'
  duration: 10s

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: StressChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
  labels:
    app: target-workload
    component: target-workload
spec:
  mode: one
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  stressors:
    memory:
      workers: 1
      size: 256MB
      options:
      - --vm-keep
  duration: 3m

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: StressChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
  labels:
    app: target-workload
    component: target-workload
spec:
  mode: one
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  stressors:
    cpu:
      workers: 2
      load: 85
  duration: 5m

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: StressChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
spec:
  mode: all
  stressors:
    cpu:
      workers: 2
      load: 50
  duration: 30s

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: HTTPChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  mode: all
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  target: Response
  port: 5001
  replace:
    headers:
      X-Chaos-Injected: 'true'
      X-Debug-Info: chaos-mesh-experiment
  duration: 5m

kind: HTTPChaos
apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
metadata:
  namespace: target-namespace
  name: yaml15-example
spec:
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
    labelSelectors:
      app: target-workload
  mode: one
  target: Response
  replace:
    code: 404
  port: 12346
  path: /example
  duration: 5m

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: DNSChaos
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  action: error
  mode: fixed-percent
  value: '10'
  selector:
    namespaces:
    - target-namespace
  patterns:
  - example.invalid
  duration: 30s

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  entry: serial-app-test
  templates:
  - name: serial-app-test
    templateType: Serial
    deadline: 1h
    children:
    - latency-injection
    - error-injection
    - recovery-test
  - name: latency-injection
    templateType: HTTPChaos
    deadline: 20m
    httpChaos:
      selector:
        namespaces:
        - target-namespace
        labelSelectors:
          app: target-workload
      mode: one
      action: delay
      delay: 300ms
      percent: '25'
      target: Service
      port: 8080
  - name: error-injection
    templateType: HTTPChaos
    deadline: 20m
    httpChaos:
      selector:
        namespaces:
        - target-namespace
        labelSelectors:
          app: target-workload
      mode: one
      action: abort
      target: Service
      port: 8080
      percent: '10'
  - name: recovery-test
    templateType: PodChaos
    deadline: 10m
    podChaos:
      selector:
        namespaces:
        - target-namespace
        labelSelectors:
          app: target-workload
      mode: one
      action: pod-failure

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: Schedule
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  schedule: 40 6 * * *
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  historyLimit: 5
  type: Workflow
  workflow:
    entry: e6
    templates:
    - name: e6
      templateType: Serial
      deadline: 10m
      children:
      - preflight-health
      - impair-and-watch
    - name: preflight-health
      templateType: StatusCheck
      deadline: 2m
      statusCheck:
        mode: Synchronous
        type: HTTP
        http:
          url: https://example.invalid/health
          method: GET
          criteria:
            statusCode: '200'
    - name: impair-and-watch
      templateType: Parallel
      deadline: 5m
      children:
      - dns-fail-dependency
      - steady-state-during
    - name: dns-fail-dependency
      templateType: DNSChaos
      deadline: 2m
      dnsChaos:
        action: error
        mode: one
        selector:
          namespaces:
          - target-namespace
          labelSelectors:
            app: target-workload
        patterns:
        - example.invalid
    - name: steady-state-during
      templateType: StatusCheck
      deadline: 4m
      statusCheck:
        mode: Continuous
        type: HTTP
        duration: 3m
        intervalSeconds: 2
        failureThreshold: 5
        recordsHistoryLimit: 100
        http:
          url: https://example.invalid/health
          method: GET
          criteria:
            statusCode: '200'

apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: yaml15-example
  namespace: target-namespace
spec:
  entry: entry
  templates:
  - name: entry
    templateType: Serial
    children:
    - stress-cpu
    - network-delay
  - name: stress-cpu
    templateType: StressChaos
    deadline: 5s
    stressChaos:
      mode: one
      selector:
        namespaces:
        - target-namespace
        labelSelectors:
          app: target-workload
      stressors:
        cpu:
          workers: 1
          load: 80
  - name: network-delay
    templateType: NetworkChaos
    deadline: 10s
    networkChaos:
      action: delay
      mode: all
      selector:
        namespaces:
        - target-namespace
        labelSelectors:
          app: target-workload
      delay:
        latency: 1s
      direction: to
